title: Fennec Shand
subtitle: Honoring the Deal
text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: Play a unit that costs 4 or less from your hand (paying its cost). Give it Ambush for this phase. (After you play the unit, it may ready and attack an enemy unit.)
deployBox:
Saboteur (When this unit attacks, ignore Sentinel and defeat the defender’s Shields.)
Action: Play a unit that costs 4 or less from your hand (paying its cost). Give it Ambush for this phase.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
Abilities that let you play a card require you to pay that card’s cost unless specified otherwise.
Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as “When Played” abilities. If there is no enemy unit that can be attacked, the unit does not ready.
The ability on Fennec’s unit side cannot be used as an action if you choose not to play a unit, as it would not change the game state.
